role: One post-processing pass: a ShaderManager plus in/out framebuffers and aux framebuffers; loadShader sets the sampler, size, ProjMat and Time uniforms and draws the fullscreen quad through the program.
scope_reason: Post-processing shader pipeline. In 1.7.10 a ShaderGroup is only built by EntityRenderer's super-secret-settings path (shaderResourceLocations) and spectator mob vision, neither reachable in this game; the native renderer implements the fixed-function pipeline in C (csrc/engine/raster.c and the raster_* files) and never compiles shader programs.

members.name: preLoadShader
members.note: fixed-function state reset before the pass

members.name: loadShader
members.note: sets DiffuseSampler, AuxSize, ProjMat, InSize, OutSize, Time, ScreenSize then draws the quad
